_caveats: Scores are panel-median rubric conformity (ranks, not absolute capability values).
Pilot and v2.4 (gate6/gate7/s8) are different bank versions and separate instruments. Evidence is era-tagged; pilot and v2.4 metrics are never averaged across eras.
Single-judge s8 J4 (Opus-4.8) and J5 (GPT-5.5) rows are stability signals only; per-SUT means in s8_per_sut_mean are means across both judges and all epochs for a given item-SUT pair.

Cohort labels use explicit new-item lists from data/session6_new_items.json and data/session7_new_items.json; v1-layer = all remaining 287-94=193 items (original pilot bank items not added in s6/s7 waves).
_parsing_notes: s8 J4/J5 raw files contain 218 rows with grade=None (channel_error: 'claude -p exited 1'); these are excluded from per-item means. s8_n_rows counts only rows with a numeric grade.
note_v1_dc_pct: v1_layer_dead_ceiling_pct counts items with verdict==DEAD-CEILING in the v1 layer (221 items). The known 53.8% figure (119/221) from session5 pilot triage is reproduced exactly here. s8-era DEAD-CEILING condition (all-SUT means>=95 and spread<5) did not add any additional items beyond those already flagged by the pilot triage.
conflicting_evidence_definition: pilot_triage_class == DEAD-CEILING but s8_cross_sut_spread >= 15 (item was ceiling-flat in pilot era but shows cross-SUT spread >=15 in v2.4 s8 runs)
cohort_method: Cohort labels built from data/session6_new_items.json (52 drafted items) and data/session7_new_items.json (42 drafted items); only the subset present in the v2.4 287-item bank are labeled: s6-new=29, s7-new=37, v1-layer=221 (287-29-37). 23 s6-draft and 5 s7-draft items are not in the v2.4 bank and are therefore absorbed into v1-layer by default.
